function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content:
It really depends on a few quick factors—what’s the occasion, what else you’re wearing, and how the color looks against your own features. Here are some simple pointers: | Factor | What to think about | |--------|---------------------| | **Occasion** | • Casual outings → Black shirts look sharp and versatile.
• Work/office (especially formal) → Pair with lighter‑toned trousers or a blazer for contrast.
• Evening events → Black can feel dramatic; add accessories or layers to soften it. | | **Skin Tone & Hair Color** | • Warm undertones (golden/yellow): Black may appear too harsh unless balanced with warm accents (e.g., mustard tie).
• Cool undertones (pink/red): Black usually complements nicely. | | **Other Colors You’ll Wear** | • Dark jeans/pants + black tee = classic monochrome vibe.
• Light pants/shoes → Black gives a nice pop. | | **Weather / Season** | • Winter/spring evenings → Black feels cozy.
• Summer daytime → Might get hot under a dark fabric; choose breathable material instead. | If you’re still unsure, try pairing the black shirt with something light (like white sneakers or khaki chinos) and see how it feels. And remember – confidence always makes any outfit work!
